about: Lifecycle track cases. Both crates/nitely-core/src/track.rs (Rust tests) and src/ui/lifecycle.test.ts (computeTrack) run every case, so the backend and the browser preview agree. `base` prepends: filed, claimed, moved to In Progress, worktree, a status, gate passed, review started. Events are [kind, summary] or [kind, summary, actor]; the actor defaults to an agent. `expect` checks only the fields it names; `reached` lists stations that must have a time and `skipped` stations that must not. `frontend_pending` marks a rule track.rs has and computeTrack does not yet: the frontend test reports it as a TODO instead of failing, so remove the field when computeTrack catches up.
